description: Whether AI models mention each brand in their answers, split by question kind: brand_named = questions that name the brand ("What do you know about X?", "Compare X with its competitors": shows whether models know the brand, not whether they recommend it unprompted) and unbranded = shopping questions that do not name it (the recommendation test). Each with rate, by model (and the platform serving it), and recent examples. Our own prompt-generation queries (keyword and shopper-question lists) are not citation tests and are left out.

domains.description: Brand domains from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. ["gymshark.com"]. Omit for all your tracked brands.
